name: Weather Board
author: buildwithnoknok
description: The weather for a place you type in the app, on a noknok Display: temperature, the weather in words, wind and rain, and a page with the next 12 hours as bars. The button LED colour follows the weather. Data: Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0). Needs your home Wi-Fi with internet, and the brain library noknok_feeds (not in a brain release yet).
assembly_guide: Connect the Display and the LED Button to the PicoHub.
Plug the Pico into power and run setup in the noknok app (home Wi-Fi with internet).
Type your town in the app (for example Bern).

controls.action: Switch between now and the next 12 hours
Yellow = clear, white = cloudy, blue = rain, cyan = snow, purple = thunderstorm

controls.control: Hold a button or the knob while plugging in
controls.action: Factory reset - keep holding until the LEDs flash / the buzzer confirms (about 8 s)

config_schema.label: Place
config_schema.help: A town name, looked up with the Open-Meteo geocoder
